items.exampleEn: Most working parents are busy in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 大多數上班的父母早上都很忙。

items.exampleEn: I tire easily in hot weather.
items.exampleZh: 天氣熱的時候我很容易累。

items.exampleEn: A short doze after lunch helps me work better.
items.exampleZh: 午餐後打個小盹，能讓我工作得更好。

items.exampleEn: Many people in big cities suffer from overwork.
items.exampleZh: 大城市裡很多人工作過度。

items.exampleEn: The shop needs two full-time workers.
items.exampleZh: 這家店需要兩名全職員工。

items.exampleEn: Hard-working bees make honey all summer.
items.exampleZh: 勤勞的蜜蜂整個夏天都在釀蜜。

items.exampleEn: I had a part-time job when I was in college.
items.exampleZh: 我大學時有一份兼職工作。

items.sentenceEn: She works part-time at a coffee shop on weekends.
items.sentenceZh: 她週末在一家咖啡店兼職。

items.audioEn: The trip was tiring, so most of the kids fell into a doze on the bus home.
items.audioZh: 這趟旅行很累人，所以回程的公車上大多數孩子都打起瞌睡。
items.questionZh: 回程的公車上，大多數孩子怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: Working full-time and studying at night is very tiring.
items.sentenceZh: 全職工作又要晚上念書，非常累人。

items.sentenceEn: The company thanked all its hard-working staff.
items.sentenceZh: 公司感謝所有勤奮的員工。

items.stemEn: Since she started her ____ job, she has been busy; she works forty hours a week.
items.stemZh: 自從開始那份全職工作，她就一直很忙，每週工作四十小時。

items.stemEn: ____ can make people tired and unhappy.
items.stemZh: 工作過度會讓人又累又不開心。

items.passageEn: My cousin Ben is a hard-working nurse. He has a full-time job at a hospital, and he also works part-time at a bookstore on Sundays. His working hours are long and irregular, and the work is very tiring. Last month, he fell into a doze on the bus and missed his stop. His family is worried that overwork will hurt his health, so he plans to take a long holiday this summer.
items.passageZh: 我表哥 Ben 是一位勤奮的護理師。他在醫院有一份全職工作，星期天還在書店兼職。他的工作時間又長又不固定，工作也很累人。上個月，他在公車上打瞌睡，坐過了站。家人擔心過度工作會傷害他的健康，所以他打算今年夏天放個長假。

questions.questionZh: Ben 星期天在哪裡兼職？
上個月 Ben 在公車上發生了什麼事？

referenceEn: Long drives really tire me out.
Driving for a long time tires me out.
rubricZh: tire 當動詞「使疲倦」，主詞是讓人累的事
主詞單複數要配合（例如 drives tire、driving tires）
寫 Long drives make me tired. 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 她是我們班上最勤奮的學生。
referenceEn: She is the most hard-working student in our class.
No one in our class is more hard-working than her.
rubricZh: 用 hard-working 表示「勤奮的」（例如 the most hard-working student；寫 hardest-working 也正確）
